prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1464; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the individual injured in the sideswipe collision that occurred while your insured was changing lanes. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly. Any statements, requests, or offers should be sent to us in writing.

Pursuant to the claim, we request a complete disclosure of the liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page and any applicable endorsements or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes the claim file, photographs, vehicle data and telematics records, dashcam or onboard video, recorded statements, adjuster notes, repair estimates, and all communications with your insured or any third party. Please suspend any routine deletion or overwriting of such material until this matter is fully resolved.

Our client's injuries and resulting losses are documented and continuing to be evaluated. We expect your prompt written acknowledgment of this letter and a response to each request above within fifteen days of receipt.
